description: This file defines the ThemeAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing theme configurations within an OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and deleting theme data, handling attachments like logos and banners, and includes validation rules for the API parameters.

classes.name: ThemeAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for theme management, including retrieval, update, and deletion of theme configurations, as well as handling attachments like logos and banners within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve the current theme details. Fetches a partial theme by name or default.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes PUT request to update theme configurations, including variables and attachment images such as logos and banners.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to reset or delete the custom theme, effectively restoring defaults.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET endpoint, excluding ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the PUT endpoint, including rules for attachment files and variables.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the DELETE endpoint, excluding ID parameter.

methods.name: getAttachmentParamRule
methods.description: Private helper to create validation rules for attachment parameters with aspect ratio constraints.
